package.name: ufil_examples_carla
package.description: UFIL example with the CARLA simulator: launch files, configuration and URDF frames for the highway and intersection scenarios. Per scenario, the head machine runs the on-board units (CARLA ground truth, CAM via UDP) and the visualization, the headless machine the outdoor sensor node, sensitive surface layer and road side unit with central fusion, and the simulation launch file a virtual sensitive surface layer mat. All parameters are in config/carla-<scenario>.yaml. Includes the docker compose setup with scripts for the CARLA server, ROS bridge and traffic manager.
package.author: cpm
